Shelley to be the Capital of Idaho for a day

May 22, 2025 Jeff Kelley
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

SHELLEY—Governor Brad Little and other State government dignitaries will visit Shelley next week to meet with the community’s citizens.

According to Lisa Ybarra, the City Clerk and Treasurer, the Governor and his entourage will meet with the citizens of Shelley at Heart to Hand Assembly Hall at 10:00 a.m. on Wednesday, May 28th. The following is a list of events during the day.
